hero.title: bayrak.ai
hero.headline: Every field job, in one trustworthy loop.
hero.tagline: Replace WhatsApp chaos with a structured field-ops loop: workers log work, auditors approve on-site, and the office tracks a live map and BOQ automatically.

problem.heading: What Happens in the Field?
problem.before_body: Work updates get buried in messages. Who did what, when, and where? The answers are lost in group chats.
problem.after_body: Every work record includes a photo, location, and quantity. The BOQ only updates once an auditor approves; the office sees everything in real time.

how.heading: How It Works
how.step1_body: Workers submit a photo, location, quantity, and notes through a familiar Telegram bot — no app download required.
how.step2_body: The auditor approves or rejects directly from Telegram using inline buttons. Decisions are instant and irreversible.
how.step3_title: Office Sees the Live Map and BOQ
how.step3_body: Every approved record appears on the Mapbox map and auto-deducts from the relevant BOQ line. No chasing, no manual entry.

features.heading: Features
features.telegram_body: Workers use the Telegram bot they already know — photo, location, quantity, and notes in a guided flow.
features.audit_body: Auditors approve or reject from the field; every decision is timestamped and documented.
features.map_body: Approved work points appear on a Mapbox map in real time. Project progress is visible at a glance.
features.boq_body: Each approval automatically deducts from the corresponding BOQ line item. The balance is always current — no manual update needed.
features.geo_body: Submission locations are checked against the project route; anomalies are flagged and the office is notified.
features.bilingual_body: Turkish Telegram bot, Turkish/English office dashboard. Ready for international auditors and mixed-language teams.

footer.tagline: Move field operations into one trustworthy loop.
